Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" ' ' Cette bibliothèque de script permet d'extraire un document ou un item d'un document. Les documents ' à extraire se trouvent dans la base de documents courante. ' ' Instructions ' 1. Renommer le script library. Le nouveau nom devrait être x_Tabl ou Tabl est le type de document. ' 2. Inscrire le nom de l'item qui contient la clé et le nom de la vue de recherche dans la section (Declarations). ' 3. Remplacer toutes les occurences de Tabl par l'identifiant du type de document. Les subs seront ' automatiquement renommés.

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_xTabl Dim gns_xTabl As Notessession Dim gndb_xTabl As Notesdatabase
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache Dim gnv_xTabl As Notesview ' La vue d'ou est extrait le document Dim gnd_xTabl As Notesdocument ' Le document qui contient les informations recherchées
' Section 3 - Les constantes à définir Const gc_NomItemCle_xTabl = "Tabl_Nom" ' Le nom de l'item servant de clé (selon la vue de recherche) Const gc_NomVue_xTabl = "V_Tabl20" ' Le nom de la vue de recherche

Function xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xIcnTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Icones As Variant Dim i As Long
xIcnTabl = 0
' Extraire les valeurs et les Icones v_Valeurs = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Icones = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Icones", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Icones) And i <= Ubound(v_Icones) Then xIcnTabl = v_Icones(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Icones) Then xIcnTabl = v_Icones(0) Else xIcnTabl = v_Icones End If End If End If End Function

Function xndTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Notesdocument ' Cette fonction retourne un document du type approprié.
' Initialisation des variables globales Call Initialisation_xTabl
' Si nécéssaire, extraire le document qui contient la variable recherchée. Call xnd(gc_NomItemCle_xTabl, p_Cle, p_Cache, gndb_xTabl, gc_NomVue_xTabl, gnv_xTabl, gnd_xTabl)
' Retourne le document défini en variable globale Set xndTabl = gnd_xTabl End Function

Function xVarTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Variant ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable d'un document.
' Extraire la variable recherchée du document retourné par la fonction xnd) xVarTabl = xVar(xndTabl(p_Cle, p_Cache), p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End Function
Sub Initialisation_xTabl ' Initialisation des variables globales If gns_xTabl Is Nothing Then Set gns_xTabl = New Notessession Set gndb_xTabl = gns_xTabl.Currentdatabase End If End Sub

Function xComplTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_NoComplement As String, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xComplTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement, "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xComplTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xComplTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Table As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem
xValeurExisteTabl = False
If Not (xndTabl(p_Table, p_Cache) Is Nothing) Then If gnd_xTabl.HasItem("Tabl_Valeurs") Then Set ni = gnd_xTabl.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Valeurs") xValeurExisteTabl = ni.Contains(p_Valeur) End If End If End Function

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Arrays" Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque de script permettent la gestion de tous les ' opérations reliés au formulaire Table | F_Tabl. '

Dim gns_FTabl As Notessession Dim gndb_FTabl As Notesdatabase Dim gnuiws_FTabl As Notesuiworkspace
' Traitement des erreurs Const gc_TypeElement_FTabl = "SL" Const gc_Element_FTabl = "F_Tabl"

Sub FTabl_Querysave(pnuid_Source As Notesuidocument, p_Continue As Variant) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument
p_Continue = False
Call FTabl_Initialisations Set nd = pnuid_Source.Document
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux descriptions Call FTabl_InitTable(nd)
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux compléments Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "1") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "2") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "3") Call FTabl_InitComplement(nd, "4")
p_Continue = True Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_InitComplement(pnd As Notesdocument, p_NoComplement As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim ni As NotesItem Dim v_aValeursComp() As String Dim i As Long
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux complément Set ni = pnd.GetFirstItem("Tabl_Complement" & p_NoComplement) If Ubound(ni.Values) > 0 Or ni.Values(0) <> "" Then Redim v_aValeursComp(Ubound(ni.Values)) As String For i = Lbound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) To Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) v_aValeursComp(i) = ni.Values(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) Next If xVar(pnd, "Tabl_TrierDescriptions", "") = "1" Then Call TrierArray(v_aValeursComp) End If Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursComp" & p_NoComplement, v_aValeursComp) Else Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursComp" & p_NoComplement, pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub
Sub FTabl_Initialisations If gns_FTabl Is Nothing Then Set gns_FTabl = New Notessession Set gndb_FTabl = gns_FTabl.Currentdatabase Set gnuiws_FTabl = New Notesuiworkspace End If End Sub

Sub FTabl_InitTable(pnd As Notesdocument) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_aValeursAlias() As String Dim v_aValeursDesc() As String Dim v_aValeursDescAlias() As String Dim v_aValeursComp1() As String Dim v_aValeursComp2() As String Dim i As Long
' Initialisation des champs cachés liés aux descriptions If Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Descriptions) > 0 Or pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(0) <> "" Then Redim v_aValeursAlias(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String Redim v_aValeursDesc(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String Redim v_aValeursDescAlias(Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs)) As String
For i = Lbound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) To Ubound(pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) v_aValeursAlias(i) = pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) v_aValeursDesc(i) = pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) & " - " & pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) v_aValeursDescAlias(i) = pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) & " - " & pnd.Tabl_Descriptions(i) & "|" & pnd.Tabl_Valeurs(i) Next
If xVar(pnd, "Tabl_TrierDescriptions", "") = "1" Then Call TrierArray(v_aValeursAlias) End If Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursAlias", v_aValeursAlias) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDesc", v_aValeursDesc) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDescAlias", v_aValeursDescAlias) Else Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursAlias", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDesc", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) Call pnd.Replaceitemvalue("Tabl_ValeursDescAlias", pnd.Tabl_Valeurs) End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_acTrierLesValeurs On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim a_Valeurs As Variant
Call FTabl_Initialisations
' Rafraîchir le document pour effectuer les validations On Error 4412 Goto FinSub Call Gnuiws_FTabl.Currentdocument.Refresh On Error 4412 Goto GererErreur
' Trier les tableaux de valeurs et de descriptions Set nd = Gnuiws_FTabl.Currentdocument.Document
' Trier les tableaux Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Descriptions") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Icones") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement1") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement2") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement3") Call FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(nd, "Tabl_Complement4")
' Trier les valeurs a_Valeurs = xVarArray(nd, "Tabl_Valeurs") If TrierArray(a_Valeurs) Then nd.Tabl_Valeurs = a_Valeurs End If FinSub: Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub FTabl_TrierLesValeurs(pnd As NotesDocument, p_NomItem As String) On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_Valeurs As Variant Dim a_Descriptions As Variant
a_Valeurs = xVarArray(pnd, "Tabl_Valeurs")
' Trier les valeurs If Ubound(a_Valeurs) > 0 Then a_Descriptions = xVarArray(pnd, p_NomItem) If Trier2Arrays(a_Valeurs, a_Descriptions) Then Call pnd.ReplaceItemValue(p_NomItem, a_Descriptions) End If End If Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_FTabl, gc_Element_FTabl, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub Querysave(Source As Notesuidocument, Continue As Variant) Call FTabl_Querysave(Source, Continue) End Sub
Option Explicit
Sub Click(Source As Button) Call FTabl_acTrierLesValeurs End Sub

code.lotusscript: Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs" Use "SL_SendKeys" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque de script permettent la gestion de tous les ' opérations reliés au formulaire Admin\Conflit | DB_SIGC. '

' Déclarations globales ' --------------------- Dim gns_SIGC As Notessession Dim gndb_SIGC As Notesdatabase
Dim gnuiws_SIGC As Notesuiworkspace Dim gnuid_SIGC As Notesuidocument Dim gnd_SIGC As Notesdocument
' Traitement des erreurs ' ---------------------- Const gc_TypeElement_SIGC = "SL" Const gc_Element_SIGC = "SI_GestionConflits"

Sub DBSIGC_hsColonneGarderValeur(p_Valeur As String) '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script initialise tous les items "GarderValeur" à la valeur reçue en paramètre. '----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim i As Long
' Initialisation des valeurs cachées ' ---------------------------------- For i = 1 To xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NbItems", 0) Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur" & Cstr(i), p_Valeur) Next
' Initialisation des valeurs affichées ' ------------------------------------ For i = 1 To 10 If xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NomItem_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "") <> "" Then Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), p_Valeur) End If Next
If p_Valeur = "1" Then Call PushShiftKey(Chr(&H9)) End If If xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_Page", 0) > 1 Then Call PushShiftKey(Chr(&H9)) End If If xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_Page", 0) < xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NbPages", 1) Then Call PushShiftKey(Chr(&H9)) End If Call PushShiftKey(Chr(&H9)) Call PushShiftKey(Chr(&H9)) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIGC, gc_Element_SIGC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBSIGC_Postopen(p_Source As Notesuidocument) '------------------------------------------------ ' Le script initialise à première page à afficher '------------------------------------------------ On Error Goto GererErreur
Set gnuid_SIGC = p_Source Set gnd_SIGC = p_Source.Document
Call DBSIGC_InitialiserPage(0) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIGC, gc_Element_SIGC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBSIGC_InitialiserPage(p_Page As Integer) '-------------------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script permet d'initialiser les champs d'affichage du masque "F_SIGC". ' Paramètre : Page à initialiser -1 = Page précédente ' 0 = Première page ' 1 = Page suivante '-------------------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Page As Long Dim v_PremierItem As Long Dim v_DernierItem As Long Dim i As Long Dim ni As Notesitem
' Première page ' ------------- If p_Page = 0 Then v_Page = 1 Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_NbPages", ((xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NbItems", 1) - 1) \ 10) + 1) ' Changement de page ' ------------------ Else ' Sauvegarde des valeurs courantes ' -------------------------------- v_Page = xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_Page", 1) v_PremierItem = ((v_Page - 1) * 10) + 1 v_DernierItem = xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_DernierItem_", 1) For i = v_PremierItem To v_DernierItem Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur" & Cstr(i), _ xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_GarderValeur_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "")) Next
' Changer de page v_Page = v_Page + p_Page End If
Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_Page", v_Page)
' Initialisation des valeurs de la nouvelle page ' ---------------------------------------------- v_PremierItem = ((v_Page - 1) * 10) + 1 v_DernierItem = v_PremierItem + 9 If v_DernierItem > xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NbItems", 0) Then v_DernierItem = xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NbItems", 0) End If
For i = v_PremierItem To v_DernierItem Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_NomItem_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_NomItem" & Cstr(i), "")) Set ni = gnd_SIGC.Getfirstitem("SIGC_ValeurOriginale" & Cstr(i)) Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_ValeurOriginale_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), ni.Text) Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_GarderValeur" & Cstr(i), "")) Set ni = gnd_SIGC.Getfirstitem("SIGC_ValeurConflit" & Cstr(i)) Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_ValeurConflit_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), ni.Text) Next
For i = v_DernierItem - v_PremierItem + 2 To 10 Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_NomItem_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "") Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_ValeurOriginale_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "") Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "") Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_ValeurConflit_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "") Next
Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_DernierItem_", v_DernierItem) Call gnuid_SIGC.RefreshHideFormulas Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIGC, gc_Element_SIGC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub DBSIGC_Initialisations If gns_SIGC Is Nothing Then Set gns_SIGC = New Notessession Set gndb_SIGC = gns_SIGC.Currentdatabase
Set gnuiws_SIGC = New Notesuiworkspace End If End Sub

Sub DBSIGC_Queryclose(p_Source As Notesuidocument, p_Continue As Variant) '-------------------------------------------------------------- ' Le script met à jour les champs de la dernière page affichée. '-------------------------------------------------------------- On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Page As Long Dim v_PremierItem As Long Dim v_DernierItem As Long Dim i As Long
Set gnuid_SIGC = p_Source Set gnd_SIGC = p_Source.Document
' Sauvegarde des valeurs courantes ' -------------------------------- v_Page = xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_Page", 1) v_PremierItem = ((v_Page - 1) * 10) + 1 v_DernierItem = xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_DernierItem_", 1) For i = v_PremierItem To v_DernierItem Call gnd_SIGC.Replaceitemvalue("SIGC_GarderValeur" & Cstr(i), _ xVar(gnd_SIGC, "SIGC_GarderValeur_" & Cstr(i Mod 10), "")) Next
p_Continue = True Exit Sub
GererErreur: Call SIGE_TraiterErreur(gc_TypeElement_SIGC, gc_Element_SIGC, Getthreadinfo(1), "", False) p_Continue = False Exit Sub End Sub

%REM /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: libSendKeys PURPOSE: A library to provide basic SendKeys functionality to Lotus Notes CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 MODIFIED: Benedict Poole - 04 October 2001 EXAMPLE CALL: Dim intTask As Integer intTask = Shell("Notepad.exe", 3) PushKeys "Here we go, some text 'typed' into Notepad, having launched it first!" /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Option Public Option Declare

Private Const VK_BREAK = &H3 ' Break = ^C Private Const VK_BELL = &H7' // Bell = ^G Private Const VK_BACK = &H8' // Backspace = ^H Private Const VK_TAB = &H9 ' // Tab = ^I Private Const VK_LINEFEED = &HA ' Line feed = ^J Private Const VK_CLEAR = &HC ' Form feed = ^L Private Const VK_RETURN = &HD ' Enter key = ^M
Private Const VK_SHIFT = &H10 ' Shift Key Private Const VK_CONTROL = &H11 ' Control key Private Const VK_MENU = &H12 ' Alt key Private Const VK_PAUSE = &H13 ' Pause?? Private Const VK_CAPITAL = &H14 ' Capslock Private Const VK_NUMLOCK = &H90 ' Numeric lock Private Const VK_SCROLL = &H91 ' Scroll lock
Private Const VK_ESCAPE = &H1B ' Escape
Private Const VK_SPACE = &H20 ' Space Private Const VK_PRIOR = &H21 ' Page Up Private Const VK_NEXT = &H22 ' Page Down Private Const VK_END = &H23' // End Private Const VK_HOME = &H24 ' Home Private Const VK_LEFT = &H25 ' Left arrow Private Const VK_UP = &H26 ' // Up arrow Private Const VK_RIGHT = &H27 ' Right arrow Private Const VK_DOWN = &H28 ' Down arrow Private Const VK_SELECT = &H29 ' Select?? Sub PushShiftKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushShiftKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle key presses whcih include the "SHIFT" key CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - key being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys, PushFNKey CALLS: sub PushAKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVKScan As Integer
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If
' // Push key PushAKey strChar
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub

Sub PushAKey(ByVal strChar As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushAKey PURPOSE: Traps the character being pressed via an API call CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strChar - character being pressed CALLED BY: subs PushKeys & PushShiftKey CALLS: sub PressKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intVirtualKey As Integer Dim intScan As Integer Dim strOEMChar As String
' // Get the virtual key code for this character intVirtualKey = VkKeyScan(Asc(strChar)) And &HFF
strOEMChar = " " ' // 2 character buffer CharToOem strChar, strOEMChar
' // Get the keyboard scan code for this key intScan = OemKeyScan(Asc(strOEMChar)) And &HFF
' // Press the key PressKey intVirtualKey, intScan End Sub

Sub PressKey(ByVal varVk As Variant, ByVal varScan As Variant) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PressKey PURPOSE: Picks up keys being pressed CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: varVK - the virtual key code of the key being pressed varScan - the keyboard scan code of the key being pressed CALLED BY: sub PushAKey CALLS: API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM keybd_event varVk, varScan, 0, 0 keybd_event varVk, varScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End Sub

Sub PushFNKey(strKeyCode As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushFNKey PURPOSE: Routine to handle function key presses - e.g. when shift or CTRL are required CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strKeyCode - CALLED BY: sub PushKeys when " { " is encountered which is SendKeys parlance denotes a function key like ALT, SHIFT or CTRL CALLS: MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim intScanKey As Integer Dim lngNumberOfPushes As Long Dim lngCtr As Integer Dim strFunctionKey As String Dim strOriginalCode As String
On Error GoTo lblPushFNKey_Errs
' // Work out which function key to push and how many times If InStr(strKeyCode, " ") > 0 Then ' // We're doing this multiple times ' // Find the rightmost space, because we want to allow people to ' // output multiple words with spaces in them. e.g. "{Seven times 7}" lngCtr = Len(strKeyCode) Do While lngCtr > 1 And Mid$(strKeyCode, lngCtr, 1) <> " " lngCtr = lngCtr - 1 Loop strOriginalCode = Left$(strKeyCode, lngCtr - 1) strFunctionKey = UCase(strOriginalCode) ' // This may fail if not a number, in which case lngNumberOfPushes will be 1 lngNumberOfPushes = CInt(Right$(strKeyCode, Len(strKeyCode) - lngCtr)) Else ' // Once only lngNumberOfPushes = 1 strFunctionKey = UCase(strKeyCode) strOriginalCode = strKeyCode End If
' // Function Keys ' // BTW, if you're reading my code, I do the for-next loop in each case rather ' // than outside the select because I figured it might be faster to do one Select ' // and the for-next loop n-times than do both the for-next and the Select >n-times. Select Case strFunctionKey Case "BACKSPACE", "BS", "BKSP" ' // Backspace intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BACK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BACK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BELL" ' // Bell = ^G intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BELL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BELL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "BREAK" ' // Break = ^C intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_BREAK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_BREAK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "CAPSLOCK", "CAPS" ' // Capslock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CAPITAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CAPITAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DELETE", "DEL" ' // Delete intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DELETE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DELETE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "DOWN" ' // Down Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DOWN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DOWN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "END" ' // End intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_END, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_END, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ENTER", "RETURN" ' // Enter = ^M intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "ESCAPE", "ESC" ' // Escape = ^[ intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ESCAPE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ESCAPE, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "FORMFEED", "FF" ' // Form feed = ^L intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_CLEAR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_CLEAR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HELP" ' // Help intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HELP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HELP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "HOME" ' // Home intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_HOME, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_HOME, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "INSERT", "INS" ' // Insert intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_INSERT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_INSERT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LEFT" ' // Left Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LEFT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LEFT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "LINEFEED", "LF" ' // Linefeed = ^J intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NEWLINE", "NL" ' // New line = Carriage return & Line Feed = ^M^J For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RETURN, 0) PressKey VK_RETURN, intScanKey intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_LINEFEED, 0) PressKey VK_LINEFEED, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMLOCK" ' // Numeric Lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMLOCK, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMLOCK, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGDN", "PAGEDOWN", "NEXT" ' // Page Down intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NEXT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NEXT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PGUP", "PAGEUP", "PRIOR" ' // Page Up intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRIOR, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRIOR, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "PRINTSCREEN", "PRTSC" ' // Print Screen intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_PRINT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_PRINT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "RIGHT" ' // Right Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_RIGHT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_RIGHT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SCROLLLOCK", "SCRLK" ' // Scroll lock intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SCROLL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SCROLL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "TAB" ' // Tab = ^I intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_TAB, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_TAB, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "UP" ' // Up Arrow intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_UP, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_UP, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "SLEEP" ' // We sleep for a few seconds DoSleep lngNumberOfPushes * 1000 Case "F1" ' // F1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F2" ' // F2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F3" ' // F3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F4" ' // F4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F5" ' // F5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F6" ' // F6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F7" ' // F7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F8" ' // F8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F9" ' // F9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F10" ' // F10 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F10, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F10, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F11" ' // F11 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F11, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F11, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F12" ' // F12 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F12, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F12, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F13" ' // F13 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F13, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F13, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F14" ' // F14 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F14, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F14, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F15" ' // F15 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F15, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F15, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F16" ' // F16 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F16, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F16, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F17" ' // F17 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F17, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F17, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F18" ' // F18 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F18, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F18, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F19" ' // F19 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F19, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F19, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F20" ' // F20 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F20, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F20, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F21" ' // F21 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F21, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F21, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F22" ' // F22 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F22, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F22, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F23" ' // F23 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F23, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F23, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "F24" ' // F24 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_F24, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_F24, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD0" ' // Numeric Keypad 0 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD0, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD0, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD1" ' // Numeric Keypad 1 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD1, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD1, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD2" ' // Numeric Keypad 2 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD2, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD2, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD3" ' // Numeric Keypad 3 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD3, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD3, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD4" ' // Numeric Keypad 4 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD4, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD4, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD5" ' // Numeric Keypad 5 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD5, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD5, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD6" ' // Numeric Keypad 6 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD6, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD6, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD7" ' // Numeric Keypad 7 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD7, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD7, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD8" ' // Numeric Keypad 8 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD8, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD8, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPAD9" ' // Numeric Keypad 9 intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_NUMPAD9, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_NUMPAD9, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADMULTIPLY", "NUMPAD*" ' // Numeric Keypad Multiply intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_MULTIPLY, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_MULTIPLY, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADADD", "NUMPAD+" ' // Numeric Keypad + intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_ADD, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_ADD, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADSUBTRACT", "NUMPAD-" ' // Numeric Keypad - intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_SUBTRACT, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_SUBTRACT, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDECIMAL", "NUMPAD." ' // Numeric Keypad . intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DECIMAL, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DECIMAL, intScanKey Next lngCtr Case "NUMPADDIVIDE", "NUMPAD/" ' // Numeric Keypad / intScanKey = MapVirtualKey(VK_DIVIDE, 0) For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PressKey VK_DIVIDE, intScanKey Next lngCtr
Case "~", "!", "@", "#", "$", "%", "^", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "+","|", "{", "}",_ """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushShiftKey strOriginalCode Next lngCtr
Case Else ' // Ordinary keys For lngCtr = 1 To lngNumberOfPushes PushKeys strOriginalCode Next lngCtr End Select Exit Sub
lblPushFNKey_Errs: ' // Should only occur when the number of pushes isn't an integer lngNumberOfPushes = 1 Resume Next End Sub

Sub PushKeys(ByVal strSource As String) %REM //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// TITLE: sub PushKeys PURPOSE: Main routine which takes input and calls sub-routines to put together SendKeys CREATED: Paul Carter, February 1998 PARAMETERS: strSource - text representing the key(s) we want to press CALLED BY: Whatever routine requires SendKeys CALLS: subs PushFNKey, PushAKey, PushShiftKey, API functions MODIFIED: Ben Poole - 04 Oct 2001 - code cleaned up w/more narrative too NOTES: Uses Win32 API calls //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// %ENDREM Dim lngCtr As Long Dim intVKScan As Integer Dim strSubString As String Dim intBracketCount As Integer Dim strOpenBracket As String Dim strCloseBracket As String Dim strTempChar As String
intShiftOn = False intControlOn = False intAltOn = False
' // Add a space to solve Mid$ problems. We won't process it. strSource = strSource + " " lngCtr = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) - 1
Select Case Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Case "+" ' // Shift key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, 0, 0 intShiftOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn shift off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intShiftOn = False Else ' // The next key is shifted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) End If
Case "^" ' // Control key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intControlOn Then ' // Turn control on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 intControlOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn control off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intControlOn = False Else ' // The next key is controlled lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intControlOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "%" ' // Alt key pressed strOpenBracket = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) If strOpenBracket = "(" Or strOpenBracket = "{" Then Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" strCloseBracket = ")" Case "{" strCloseBracket = "}" End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" intBracketCount = 1 Do While lngCtr <= Len(strSource) And intBracketCount <> 0 lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strTempChar = Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) If strTempChar <> strCloseBracket Then strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) Else intBracketCount = intBracketCount - 1 End If If strTempChar = strOpenBracket Then intBracketCount = intBracketCount + 1 Loop
If Not intAltOn Then ' // Turn Alt on intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 intAltOn = True End If
' // Push the keys Select Case strOpenBracket Case "(" PushKeys strSubString Case "{" PushFNKey strSubString End Select
' // Turn alt off intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 intAltOn = False Else ' // The next key is Alted lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 If Not intAltOn Then intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, 0, 0 End If PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If
Case "{" ' // Function keys lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 strSubString = "" Do While lngCtr < Len(strSource) And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) <> "}" strSubString = strSubString + Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop If Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1) = "}" And Mid$(strSource, lngCtr + 1, 1) = "}" Then ' // Right brace PushShiftKey "}" lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Else PushFNKey strSubString End If
Case "A" To "Z", "!", "@", "#", "$", "&", "*", "(", ")", "_", "|", """", ":", "?", ">", "<" ' // Shifted keys PushShiftKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
Case "~" ' // The enter key PushFNKey "ENTER"
Case Else PushAKey Mid$(strSource, lngCtr, 1)
End Select
lngCtr = lngCtr + 1 Loop
If intShiftOn Then ' // Turn shift off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_SHIFT, 0) keybd_event VK_SHIFT, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intControlOn Then ' // Turn control off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_CONTROL, 0) keybd_event VK_CONTROL, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If If intAltOn Then ' // Turn alt off if need be intVKScan = MapVirtualKey(VK_MENU, 0) keybd_event VK_MENU, intVKScan, KEYEVENTF_KEYUP, 0 End If End Sub
Dim g_Isnewdoc As Integer
Sub Postopen(Source As Notesuidocument) g_Isnewdoc = Source.Isnewdoc End Sub
Sub Postsave(Source As Notesuidocument) ' Rafraichir le titre lorsqu'un document est sauvegardé pour la première fois. If g_Isnewdoc Then Call Source.Refresh g_Isnewdoc = False End If End Sub

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" ' ' Les fonctions définies dans cette bibliothèque de script permettent d'extraire de l'information de la base de ' documents SI_GDK. ' ' Fonctions disponibles ' ' ================ ' xndNDB ' ================ ' Extraire un document de type F_NDB (Notes database). ' Syntaxe: flag = xndNDB( Cle , Cache ) ' Paramètres: Cle String. Le nom usuel de la base de documents pour laquelle on veut ' extraire le document de type NDB. ' Cache Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il ' correspond au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le ' document est relu même s'il est déjà en mémoire. ' Valeur retournée: Notesdocument. Le document recherché. Retourne Nothing si aucun document n'est ' trouvé pour la clé spécifiée. ' ' ================ ' xVarNDB ' ================ ' Extrait la valeur d'un document de type F_NDB (Notes database). ' Syntaxe: flag = xVarNDB( Cle , NomVar , ValeurNulle , Cache ) ' Paramètres: Cle String. Le nom usuel de la base de documents pour laquelle on veut ' extraire le document de type NDB. ' NomVar String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ValeurNulle Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas ' dans le document recherché. ' Cache Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il ' correspond au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le ' document est relu même s'il est déjà en mémoire. ' Valeur retournée: La valeur de la variable recherchée. Si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le ' document, retourne la valeur du paramètre ValeurNulle. ' ' ================ ' xndbNDB ' ================ ' Extrait une base de documents Notes. ' Syntaxe: flag = xVarNDB( Cle ) ' Paramètres: Cle String. Le nom usuel de la base de documents qu'on veut obtenir. ' Valeur retournée: Notesdatabase. La base de documents identifiée par la clé dans le GDK. Si la base de ' documents n'existe pas, retourne une base de documents fermée ' (propriété IsOpen = False). ' ' ================ ' xndTabl ' ================ ' Extraire un document de type F_Tabl (Table). ' Syntaxe: flag = xndTabl( Cle , Cache ) ' Paramètres: Cle String. Le nom de la table à extraire. ' Cache Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il ' correspond au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le ' document est relu même s'il est déjà en mémoire. ' Valeur retournée: Notesdocument. Le document recherché. Retourne Nothing si aucun document n'est ' trouvé pour la clé spécifiée. ' ' ================ ' xVarTabl ' ================ ' Extrait la valeur d'un document de type F_Tabl (Table). ' Syntaxe: flag = xVarTabl( Cle , NomVar , ValeurNulle , Cache ) ' Paramètres: Cle String. Le nom de la table à extraire. '' NomVar String. Le nom de la variable contenant la valeur recherchée. ' ValeurNulle Variant. La valeur à retourner si la variable recherchée n'existe pas ' dans le document recherché. ' Cache Boolean. Indiquer True pour réutiliser le document en mémoire lorsqu'il ' correspond au document recherché. Si vous indiquez False, le ' document est relu même s'il est déjà en mémoire. ' Valeur retournée: La valeur de la variable recherchée. Si la variable recherchée n'existe pas dans le ' document, retourne la valeur du paramètre ValeurNulle. '

' Section 1 - Paramètres de la session - Définis dans le sub Initialisation_XXX ' - La session (gns_XXX) sera déclarée une seule fois pour le script library. ' - La base de documents (gndbZZZ_XXX) d'où provient le document recherché. Dim gns_xGDK As Notessession Dim gndbGDK_xGDK As Notesdatabase Dim gndbGDKServeur_xGDK As Notesdatabase Dim gnd_Prof_GDK As NotesDocument
' Section 2 - Définition des valeurs conservées dans la cache ' Répéter pour chaque type de document ' - La vue (gnvYYY_XXX) d'ou est extrait le document ' - Le document (gndYYY_XXX) qui contient les informations recherchées
' Base de documents Dim gnvNDB1_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndNDB_xGDK As NotesDocument Dim gnvNDB1Serveur_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndNDBServeur_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Compteurs Dim gnvComp_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndComp_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Tables Dim gnvTabl_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndTabl_xGDK As NotesDocument Dim gnvTablServeur_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndTablServeur_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Messages Dim gnv_xGDK As NotesView Dim gnd_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Bannières SDS Dim gnvBann_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndBann_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Medias Dim gnvTypM_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndTypM_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Application Dim gnvAApp_xGDK As NotesView Dim gndAApp_xGDK As NotesDocument
' Table des abbréviations: ' XXX = Abbréviation trouvée dans le nom du script library courant ' YYY = Identifiant du type d'information (2e partie de l'alias d'un masque) ' ZZZ = Identifiant de la base de documents (abbréviation)
Declare Function ShellExecute Lib "shell32.dll" Alias "ShellExecuteA" (Byval hwnd As Long, Byval lpOperation As String, Byval lpFile As String, Byval lpParameters As String, Byval lpDirectory As String, Byval nShowCmd As Long) As Long
Const SW_HIDE = 0 Const SW_SHOWNORMAL = 1 Const SW_NORMAL = 1 Const SW_SHOWMINIMIZED = 2 Const SW_SHOWMAXIMIZED = 3 Const SW_MAXIMIZE = 3 Const SW_SHOWNOACTIVATE = 4 Const SW_SHOW = 5 Const SW_MINIMIZE = 6 Const SW_SHOWMINNOACTIVE = 7 Const SW_SHOWNA = 8 Const SW_RESTORE = 9 Const SW_SHOWDEFAULT = 10 Const SW_MAX = 10

Le nom du champs servant de clé dans le document recherché. ' 2 Variant. La valeur de la clé recherchée. ** Ne pas modifier ** ' 3 Boolean. Function xGDK_xndbNDB(Byval pCle As Variant) As NotesDatabase ' Cette fonction retourne une base de documents.
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase
' Initialisation des variables globales Set xGDK_xndbNDB = Nothing Call xGDK_Initialisations
' Retourne la base de documents Set ndb = gns_xGDK.Getdatabase(xGDK_xVarNDB(pCle, "NDB_Serveur", "", False), _ xGDK_xVarNDB(pCle, "NDB_Fichier", "", True), False) If Not ndb Is Nothing Then If ndb.Isopen Then Set xGDK_xndbNDB = ndb Else Set xGDK_xndbNDB = Nothing End If End If End Function

Function xGDK_xExtraireAApp(Byval pCle As Variant, Byval pCache As Integer, p_CheminAcces As String, p_Executer As Boolean) As Boolean ' Cette fonction retourne un document de type F_NDB. On Error 75 Resume Next 'Path/File Error ===> fichier "locké" au niveau du kill
Dim nd_AApp As NotesDocument Dim nrti As NotesRichTextItem Dim aneo As Variant Dim neo As NotesEmbeddedObject Dim v_Dossier As String Dim i As Integer
xGDK_xExtraireAApp = False
' Extraire le document de l'application Set nd_AApp = xGDK_xndAApp(pCle, pCache) If nd_AApp Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If
Set nrti = nd_AApp.GetFirstItem("AApp_Executable") If Not Isarray(nrti.Embeddedobjects) Then Exit Function End If aneo = nrti.EmbeddedObjects Set neo = aneo(Lbound(aneo))
' Créer le dossier temporaire (au besoin) If p_CheminAcces = "" Then v_Dossier = Environ("Temp") & "\AApp" p_CheminAcces = v_Dossier & "\" & neo.Source Elseif Instr(p_CheminAcces, "\") > 0 Then v_Dossier = Strleftback(p_CheminAcces, "\") Else v_Dossier = Environ("Temp") & "\AApp" p_CheminAcces = v_Dossier & "\" & p_CheminAcces End If Mkdir v_Dossier
' Extraire l'application Kill p_CheminAcces Call neo.Extractfile(p_CheminAcces) xGDK_xExtraireAApp = True
' Executer le fichier If p_Executer Then If Lcase(Strrightback(p_CheminAcces, ".")) = "exe" Then i = Shell(p_CheminAcces, 1) Else Call ShellExecute(0&, "open", p_CheminAcces, Null, Strleftback(p_CheminAcces, "\"), SW_SHOWDEFAULT) End If End If End Function

Function xGDK_xndbGDK As NotesDatabase ' Cette fonction retourne la base de documents GDK.
Call xGDK_Initialisations Set xGDK_xndbGDK = gndbGDK_xGDK End Function

Function xGDK_xDescTabl(Byval p_Cle As String, Byval p_Table As String, Byval p_Cache As Integer) As String ' Cette fonction retourne la description d'un élément d'une table.
Dim v_Valeurs As Variant Dim v_Descriptions As Variant Dim i As Long
xGDK_xDescTabl = ""
' Extraire les valeurs et les descriptions v_Valeurs = xGDK_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Valeurs", "", True) v_Descriptions = xGDK_xVarTabl(p_Table, "Tabl_Descriptions", "", True)
' S'il n'y a plusieurs valeurs, rechercher la valeur recherchée If Isarray(v_Valeurs) Then For i = Lbound(v_Valeurs) To Ubound(v_Valeurs) If v_Valeurs(i) = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then If i >= Lbound(v_Descriptions) And i <= Ubound(v_Descriptions) Then xGDK_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(i) End If End If
Exit For End If Next
' S'il n'y a qu'une valeur, et qu'elle correspond à la valeur recherchée, retourner la description Else If v_Valeurs = p_Cle Then If Isarray(v_Descriptions) Then xGDK_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions(0) Else xGDK_xDescTabl = v_Descriptions End If End If End If End Function

Function xGDK_xVarProf(Byval p_NomVar As String, Byval p_ValeurNulle As Variant) As Variant On Error Goto GererErreur ' Cette fonction retourne la valeur d'une variable du profil de la base de documents.
' Initialisation des variables globales xGDK_xVarProf = p_ValeurNulle Call xGDK_Initialisations
' Extraire le document de profil If gnd_Prof_GDK Is Nothing Then Set gnd_Prof_GDK = gndbGDK_xGDK.Getprofiledocument("F_Prof") End If
If Not (gnd_Prof_GDK Is Nothing) Then xGDK_xVarProf = xVar(gnd_Prof_GDK, p_NomVar, p_ValeurNulle) End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Print "Erreur x_GDK. " & Getthreadinfo(1) & " ligne " & Erl & " - " Error$ & " (" & Cstr(Err) & ")" Exit Function End Function

Function xGDK_TypeNDBCourante As String ' Cette fonction retourne le type de la base de documents courante ' P = Production, L = Local, T = Tests On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim a_DossiersTests As Variant Dim v_Dossier As String Dim v_LongDossier As Integer Dim i As Integer
xGDK_TypeNDBCourante = "T" Call xGDK_Initialisations
If Not (gndbGDK_xGDK Is Nothing) Then If gndbGDK_xGDK.Server = "" Or Lcase(gndbGDK_xGDK.Server) = "local" Then xGDK_TypeNDBCourante = "L" Elseif Instr(Lcase(gndbGDK_xGDK.Server), "zulu") > 0 Then Exit Function Else a_DossiersTests = xGDK_xVarProf("Prof_DossiersTests", "") If Not Isarray(a_DossiersTests) Then If a_DossiersTests = "" Then xGDK_TypeNDBCourante = "P" Exit Function Elseif a_DossiersTests = "*" Then Exit Function End If a_DossiersTests = Evaluate(|"| & a_DossiersTests & |"|) End If v_Dossier = Lcase(gndbGDK_xGDK.Filepath) If Right(v_Dossier, 1) <> "\" Then v_Dossier = v_Dossier & "\" End If v_LongDossier = Len(v_Dossier) For i = Lbound(a_DossiersTests) To Ubound(a_DossiersTests) If Len(a_DossiersTests(i)) > v_LongDossier Then If Left(Lcase(a_DossiersTests(i)), v_LongDossier) = v_Dossier Then Exit Function End If End If Next xGDK_TypeNDBCourante = "P" End If End If Exit Function
GererErreur: Print "Erreur x_GDK. " & Getthreadinfo(1) & " ligne " & Erl & " - " Error$ & " (" & Cstr(Err) & ")" Exit Function End Function

Function xGDK_xRemplacerParametres(Byval p_Message As String, p_Parametres As Variant) As String Dim v_Pos As Long Dim v_Message1 As String Dim v_Message2 As String Dim v_Message3 As String Dim v_NoParm As String
v_Pos = Instr(p_Message, "&") If v_Pos = 0 Then xGDK_xRemplacerParametres = p_Message Exit Function End If
' Extraire la chaine à gauche de la valeur à insérer v_Message1 = Left(p_Message, v_Pos - 1)
' Extraire le numéro du paramètre à insérer If v_Pos < Len(p_Message) Then v_NoParm = Mid(p_Message, v_Pos + 1, 1) If Instr("0123456789", v_NoParm) = 0 Then v_NoParm = "0" Else v_Pos = v_Pos + 1 End If Else v_NoParm = "0" End If
' Extraire le paramètre à insérer v_Message2 = "" If Isarray(p_Parametres) Then If v_NoParm <= Ubound(p_Parametres) Then v_Message2 = p_Parametres(Cint(v_NoParm)) End If Elseif v_NoParm = "0" Then v_Message2 = p_Parametres End If
' Extraire la chaine à droite de la valeur à insérer If v_Pos < Len(p_Message) Then v_Message3 = xGDK_xRemplacerParametres(Right(p_Message, Len(p_Message) - v_Pos), p_Parametres) Else v_Message3 = "" End If
' Construire le message xGDK_xRemplacerParametres = v_Message1 & v_Message2 & v_Message3 End Function

Function xGDK_xFormulaNDB(Byval pCle As Variant) As String ' Cette fonction retourne le serveur et le chamin d'accès utilisé par les formules ' @DbLookup et @DbColumn
Dim ndb As NotesDatabase
' Extraire la base de documents Set ndb = xGDK_xndbNDB(pCle)
xGDK_xFormulaNDB = |"| & ndb.Server & |":"| & Replace(ndb.FilePath,"\","\\") & |"| End Function

Function xGDK_xValeurExisteTabl(Byval p_Cle As Variant, p_Valeur As Variant, _ Byval p_Cache As Integer) As Integer Dim ni As NotesItem

Function xGDK_xMessage(Byval p_NomDocument As String, Byval p_NoMessage As Integer, _ Byval p_Langue As String, p_Parametres As Variant) As String Dim v_Langue As Variant Dim v_Message As String Dim ni_Messages As NotesItem Dim va As Variant Dim v_Pos As Long Dim v_Suivant As String Dim v_NoParm As Integer
Const c_MessageVide = "SIMs_MessageVide"
Call xGDK_Initialisations xGDK_xMessage = "" If p_NoMessage < 0 Or gndbGDK_xGDK Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If ' Initialiser le document de messages si pas passé en paramètre If p_NomDocument = "" Then p_NomDocument = "SI" End If ' Initialiser la langue si pas passée en paramètre If p_Langue = "" Then p_Langue = "FR" v_Langue = Evaluate("@UpperCase(@Left(@LanguagePreference([Content]); 2))") If Isarray(v_Langue) Then If v_Langue(0) = "EN" Then p_Langue = v_Langue(0) End If End If End If
' Extraire le document des messages ' --------------------------------- If xVar(gnd_xGDK, "SIMs_Nom", "") <> p_NomDocument Then If gnv_xGDK Is Nothing Then Set gnv_xGDK = gndbGDK_xGDK.Getview("V_SIMs20") End If Set gnd_xGDK = gnv_xGDK.GetDocumentbykey(p_NomDocument) If gnd_xGDK Is Nothing Then Exit Function End If End If
' Extraire le message d'une langue autre que Français ' --------------------------------------------------- If p_Langue <> "FR" Then Set ni_Messages = gnd_xGDK.GetFirstItem("SIMs_Messages" & p_Langue) If Not (ni_Messages Is Nothing) Then va = ni_Messages.Values If Ubound(va) >= p_NoMessage Then If va(p_NoMessage) <> c_MessageVide Then v_Message = va(p_NoMessage) End If End If End If End If
' Extraire le message Français ' ---------------------------- If v_Message = "" Then Set ni_Messages = gnd_xGDK.GetFirstItem("SIMs_MessagesFR") If Not (ni_Messages Is Nothing) Then va = ni_Messages.Values If Ubound(va) >= p_NoMessage Then If va(p_NoMessage) <> c_MessageVide Then v_Message = va(p_NoMessage) End If End If End If End If
' Effectuer les substitutions ' --------------------------- If v_Message <> "" Then xGDK_xMessage = xGDK_xRemplacerParametres(v_Message, p_Parametres) End If End Function

Sub Initialize Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim nnc As NotesNoteCollection
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim v_NotesID As String Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim v_NbProfil As Long Dim v_aCle() As String Dim v_Continue As Integer
Dim v_Selection As Variant Dim nuiws As New Notesuiworkspace
' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Extraire les documents de profil Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set nnc = ndb.CreateNoteCollection(False) nnc.SelectProfiles = True Call nnc.BuildCollection
' Bâtir la liste des documents de profil v_NbProfil = -1 v_NotesID = nnc.GetFirstNoteId Do Until v_NotesID = "" Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentByID(v_NotesID) v_NbProfil = v_NbProfil + 1 Redim Preserve v_aCle(v_NbProfil) As String v_aCle(v_NbProfil) = xVar(nd, "$NAME", "") & ":" & v_NotesID v_Continue = True
v_NotesID = nnc.GetNextNoteId(v_NotesID) Loop
If v_Continue Then Call TrierArray(v_aCle) ' Demander à l'utilisateur de sélectionner le profil à supprimer v_Selection = nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELLIST, "Modification d'un profil", _ "Sélectionnez le document de profil à modifier.", "", v_aCle) If v_Selection <> "" Then ' Supprimer le document de profil v_NotesID = Strrightback(v_Selection, ":") Set nd = ndb.GetDocumentByID(v_NotesID) Call nd.EditDocument End If Else Messagebox "Il n'y a aucun document de profil dans la base de documents.", 16, _ "Opération annulée" End If End Sub

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions"

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim nuiws As New NotesUIWorkspace
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim ndc As NotesDocumentCollection Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NomItem As String Dim v_Valeur As String Dim v_Resultat As Variant Dim v_Maj As Boolean Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set ndc = ndb.UnprocessedDocuments If ndc.Count = 0 Then Print "Aucun document sélectionné" Exit Sub End If
' Demander le nom du champs à modifier v_NomItem = nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELEDIT, "Nom de l'item", _ "Veuillez saisir le nom de l'item à modifier.") If v_NomItem = "" Then Print "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Demander la nouvelle valeur v_Valeur = nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OKCANCELEDIT, "Nouvelle valeur", _ "Veuillez saisir la formule à utiliser pour calculer la nouvelle valeur de l'item " & v_NomItem & "." & Chr(10) & _ " - Saisir *DEL pour supprimer l'item") If v_Valeur = "" Then Print "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
' Demander une confirmation If v_Valeur = "*DEL" Then If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, Cstr(ndc.Count) & " documents sélectionnés", _ "Voulez-vous supprimer l'item " & v_NomItem & " ?") <> 1 Then Print "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If Else If nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_YESNO, Cstr(ndc.Count) & " documents sélectionnés", _ "Voulez-vous remplacer la valeur l'item " & v_NomItem & _ " par le résultat de la formule « " & v_Valeur & " » ?") <> 1 Then Print "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If End If
Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = ndc.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
'***** Insérer les instructions de correction içi ***** v_Maj = False If v_Valeur = "*DEL" Then If nd.HasItem(v_NomItem) Then Call nd.RemoveItem(v_NomItem) v_Maj = True End If Else v_Resultat = Evaluate(v_Valeur, nd) If Isarray(v_Resultat) Then If Ubound(v_Resultat) = 0 Then v_Resultat = v_Resultat(0) End If Call nd.ReplaceItemValue(v_NomItem, v_Resultat) v_Maj = True End If End If If v_Maj Then Call nd.save(True, True) v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Call nuiws.CurrentView.DeselectAll Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub
GererErreur: Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Call nuiws.Prompt(PROMPT_OK, GetThreadInfo(1), "Erreur " & Cstr(Err()) & " à la ligne " & Cstr(Erl()) & ": " & Error()) Exit Sub End Sub

Sub Initialize On Error Goto GererErreur
Dim v_Roles As Variant Dim ns As New Notessession Dim ndb As Notesdatabase Dim nv As NotesView Dim nd As Notesdocument Dim nd_Suivant As Notesdocument Dim v_NbLus As Long Dim v_NbMaj As Long
' Doit avoir le rôle Admin pour utiliser cette action v_Roles = Evaluate(|@IsMember("[Admin]"; @UserRoles)|) If v_Roles(0) <> 1 Then Messagebox "Vous n'êtes pas autorisé à utiliser cette action.", 16, "Opération annulée" Exit Sub End If
Set ndb = ns.Currentdatabase Set nv = ndb.GetView("V_SIGC")
Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getfirstdocument Do Until nd_Suivant Is Nothing Set nd = nd_Suivant Set nd_Suivant = nv.Getnextdocument(nd_Suivant) v_NbLus = v_NbLus + 1
'***** Insérer les instructions de correction içi ***** If SIGC_ResoudreConflit(nd, 1, "") Then v_NbMaj = v_NbMaj + 1 End If
If (v_NbLus Mod 1000) = 0 Then Print Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) End If Loop
Print "Fin " & Cstr(v_NbMaj) & "/" & Cstr(v_NbLus) Exit Sub

Option Public Option Explicit Use "SI_Extractions" Use "SI_GestionErreurs"

' Déclarations globales ' ----------------------------------
